question: In aqueous solutions, the amphiphilic molecules form micelles above the micellar critical concentration and the Kraft temperature. This spontaneous process is due to:

options.opa: A decrease in the enthalpy of the system due to the formation of micelles.
options.opb: An increase in the enthalpy of the system due to the formation of micelles.
options.opc: A decrease in the free energy of the system due to the formation of micelles.
options.opd: An increase in the free energy of the system due to the formation of micelles.

analysis: In aqueous solutions, the formation of micelles by amphiphilic molecules is a spontaneous process driven by a decrease in the free energy of the system due to the formation of micelles.
